headline: Daily research brief — Monday, October 5

items.detail: No watchlist earnings and no ex-divs inside the window — short-dated premium written now carries no embedded binary. But the front-30-day IV term structure already shows event humps: TSLA Oct 21 (AMC, company-confirmed), MSFT ~Oct 27-28 (date unverified), AAPL Oct 29. Elevated IV into these is event pricing, not edge. Clean front-window names: SPY, QQQ, NVDA — and NVDA's IV/RV 1.15 is thin, not a fat pitch.

items.detail: US retail diesel sits at a record $6.53/gal; VLCC Middle East-to-Asia above $1.2M/day, up from ~$30k/day in January; freight and insurance are ~27% of a delivered barrel, up from ~3%. Yet WTI Dec-27 at $76.22 vs front $89.38 — steep backwardation, pricing normalization in 12-18 months. Bab el-Mandeb escalation keeps the war premium fat; OPEC+ held November quotas with the next decision Nov 1.
items.title: Diesel, not crude, is the macro variable
